question: Does contextual residual adaptation improve matched Stage5 detector AP?
design: 3 seeds, paired. stage7-seed{s} (contextual residual refinement) vs stage5-baseline-seed{s} (frozen Stage5, epoch 0). Same 36717 official validation frames, same YOLO candidates, same contextual cache.
headline: Against frozen Stage 5, five of seven metrics improve significantly. Against its own context source, Stage 7 is worse on duplex/triplet/tail47/deep28 across all three seeds. See baseline_choice_correction.
interpretation_caution: The gains concentrate in common and overall metrics. Long-tail composition, which is the thesis argument, is not significantly improved by this comparison. Do not present tail47/deep28 gains as established.
protocol_caveats: Baselines are frozen Stage5 at epoch 0, so this is a large architectural delta, not a controlled ablation.
Protocol records its own exposure risk: 'Context fusion family chosen after prior official validation results; exploratory follow-up, not a fresh blind test.'
Protocol specifies no direct phrase-score input to the Stage5 readout; language flows through the contextual RoI. This addresses the phrase-score double-route concern raised for the all184 head.
tracking_note: This study ran untracked for about an hour on 2026-09-18 because session_status.py had its study list hardcoded. The script now discovers any artifact directory containing pipeline-progress.json.
workbook_status: Not written to the results workbook. Pending user decision.

baseline_choice_correction.issue: The headline paired test compares Stage 7 against frozen Stage 5 (epoch 0), a weak comparator. Stage 7 is initialised from the same-seed mlp-contrastive-all184 checkpoint, so that contextual head is the correct comparator.
baseline_choice_correction.verdict: Stage 7 is WORSE than its own context source on duplex, triplet, tail47 and deep28, negative on all three seeds for each. None clears |t|>4.303 at n=3, but sign consistency is total. Bridging contextual evidence into frozen Stage 5 subtracts value relative to letting the contextual head classify directly.
baseline_choice_correction.reframing: The defensible claim is that contextual evidence is worth a large amount (frozen Stage 5 10.16 -> contextual head 12.17). The Stage 7 bridge is not the source of that gain and costs roughly 0.42 triplet and 0.69 tail47 against the head it is built from.
baseline_choice_correction.best_long_tail: attention-classification (classification-only contextual head, no contrastive, no Stage 5): tail47 6.19, deep28 4.48 - the best tail numbers in either study.
